notes.title: Update 1.5 - UI Enhancements & Shorter Turns & Game Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/81188e958353359151cd249df73bee1ff29bba1f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Many reviews of the game stated that the UI could be improved, so this update tries to fix it's issues as well as other additions that felt necessary!

[*] Pass Turn wait time should be significantly shorter now, especially in late game!
[*] Tech Progression window has been significantly improved!

[/list]
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/cOGjkbHzdtR1eAQHFU/giphy.gif?cid=790b761179f082cb3ab191fa678595e9c4ba3c275c10baee&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]
[list]
[*] Properties now have unique sounds to them when selected.
[*] select agent from "all agents" will now allow you to sort by skill!
[*] "Escape" should now hide the UI before leaving the map view
[*] You are now able to control the "Ambience" volume (Rain / Wind / Etc...)
[*] Property with an upgrade in progress will now have a unique icon to it.
[*] Property with something in it's inventory will now have a unique icon to it.
[*] Circular agent / task selection has been improved!
[*] Customize Character will no longer hide "Opinion"
[*] Prevent any sound from being spammed more than 3 times together.
[*] "All Characters" window has been improved in terms of functionality and performance
[*] Properties that get destroyed will no longer lose their ownership!
[*] Employees will no longer whisper you about rumors that you plan to betray yourself (and other related events)
[*] "Hover Models" (Mug for tavern) of your properties are now always visible on the map!
[*] Now able to navigate between agents / properties with small "navigation arrows" next to it's portrait
[*] Agent selection now has a small "Character Info" Button
[*] Slightly less rain
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
We have recently returned focus back to Waiting For The Raven.
A sandbox scenario has been requested since the game's Early Access days, it has now come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/b636745cdc1f7398e688c9fd07c2daa349129cee.png[/img]

You may unlock this chapter by completing one of the Oracles very early missions - "Research Business".

We may improve upon this sandbox, using your suggestions and adding more mechanics / tension / survival / strategic options / paths.

The game now allows you to customize any character:
(Only available in the sandbox chapter)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/f221e34a3b3153dd25894773e0c7b93c7fb40780.png[/img]

and any faction:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/73a8a441e5d8d27a008bc38604cf5f9afe5ebe48.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/f78c1f6a1dd57e865935677a655a94907ee0c9bc.png[/img]

To do so, press on the newly added Quill & Ink button in the Character / Faction - Info Windows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/fb6947391332b8328e8e54b663db6d6e37d5f3d0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/e7b7339207d1a72548a1ca443806ffc9f14e0cec.png[/img]



We have implemented a new compression method to our build process, significantly decreasing its size on disk!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/234d07ba38d6a7caba4ff7e364c886b43880a5e7.png[/img]

We have also updated the version of the engine this game runs on.


Note 1: We do acknowledge an update that fixes recently reported bugs surely must come, and as soon as possible.

Note 2: New bugs / glitches / issues may appear after the recent implementation, we may only ask you to please be patient with us since our development resource is somewhat small.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]


[*]Added infrastructure which should prevent any turns from hanging forever and also report all of the past turn-freeze errors automatically back to the developer.

[*]Fixed a turn-freeze bug which had occurred due to a rare case with smugglers not being able to generate new items.

[*]Fixed shivering’s duel from getting stuck in some specific dialogues due to the fact that you work for Silkstring and not Fayette or The Oracles.

[*]Some locations lose their “Disallowed Actions”  upon game load, resulting in players being able to burn the cemetery and so on. 

[*]Added “Unlock Constabulary & Cult Of Flesh” to the Cheat Menu which can be toggled from within the game via SHIFT+END

[*]Improved Loading Screen with additional effects so it won’t seem static.

[*]Added inverted mouse ability in the options menu


[*]

notes.title: Update - Version 1.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rg7RBmEIuwE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]












[u][b]V1.0 Changes[/b][/u]




[u][b]Additions[/b][/u]

[*]Added a cutscene to the Constabulary chapter.

[*]Added a cutscene to the Secret Society Of Flesh chapter.

[*]Saving game panel will appear when the game auto-saves.

[*]Add the ability to see why reputation was lowered/increased (Turn Report)

[*]Bookkeeper release from jail should also increase rep.

[*]Harold from the constabulary chapter has been too difficult to question.

[*]Added a small label near locations inventories which indicate that the inventory refreshes every turn.

[*]Time to go mad as AJX has been slightly increased… (Slower)

[*]You may now sort by name in character windows.

[*]Secret Society Of Flesh starts with more cultists (So the cult will grow faster)

[*]End Credits Modified to have the new voice actors.

[*]Additional Game Wide Misc Adjustments.




[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[*]Plot cache still saves characters which are no longer in your faction / in prison / dead.

[*]Constabulary could generate heat behind the scenes...

[*]Recruitment Pools would not refresh every turn...

[*]An error which causes a turn pass freeze as a result of faction leaders dying in unique ways and the 
AI has no faction to handle.

[*]Log spamming harmless errors fixed.

[*]Fixed potential memory leak with information gathering / trait checking /  -  quest objectives…

[*]Fixed a long lag which occurs after these types of quest objective has been validated.

[*]Lionel Spinkel (Head Constable) will no appear on the Safe Landing quest details for easy reach.

[*]Fixed harmless error in non-cult chapters.

[*]Sometimes traitor employees would still be controlled by an AI even if they already moved to your side. And may no longer buy properties for you on their own balance.

[*]“Betray employer” bribe option is no longer possible with characters that don’t have an employer (Faction leader)

[*]‘David’ and ‘Elice’ are your cultists even when you play oracles.

[*]A critical problem in which autosave would be delayed in realtime seconds and save during turn pass.

[*]Input fields are now alphanumeric and will not support illegal letters which may produce an error when saving files / etc…

[*]“Game has been saved “  notification should be changed to “Save Game?” (The message is incorrect to the state of saving & player may dismiss it.)

[*]Interrogation Popups had bad fields in them (Displaying <ActorName> instead of the actor’s name.

[*]Selling prisoners should now release them from prison… & make them unimprisonable (So if they didn’t die they will still not be abused)

[*]You may no longer enter the final stage of SSOF with maddening voices and illusions.

[*]Fixed a bug with justice case elements not being properly loaded from save. And resulting in a turn freeze after the following auto-save.

[*]Fixed a bug with justice case elements not being properly saved, and preventing the save file from being created.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/ce79193bdc812215a9bd8d2490bb359596622e03.jpg[/img]

More updates may come in the future! (not in a form of costly DLCs, don't worry.)
This game has a whole lot more to explore and hasn't yet depleted it's potential!

For all of the faithful players who played the early version of the game, reported bugs, suggested ideas and helped with the improvement of the game's experience & overall quality, thank you! This game owes many of it's qualities to you.

I must thank you personally aswell for your enthusiasm, time investment and interest in this creation, I am a lone developer and the motivation your feedback had brought to me was the thing that kept me going through this very long process.

While this may not be the best game out there, I believe the unique concepts and ideas it contains may at least provide the strategy genre with new and untried gaming experiences.

[*]

notes.title: Update - Version 0.7
notes.content:
[b][u]IMPORTANT NOTES[/u][/b]

When loading an older save file, the game will not invoke events that happened in past turns and was added in the new version (For example, a save file past turn 40 will not have the “Strange Letter” chain quest)


[u][b]Additions[/b][/u]


[*]Quicker agent selection for missions.

[*]Letter from the Brotherhood of The Mirror at turn 20

[*]Letter from a friend at turn 30

[*]Corruption Achievement

[*]Raids should steal 20% of the faction’s resources/.

[*]Togglable "Flee on failure" (The agents will flee and avoid a fight whenever a non-violent plot method is used)


[u][b]Bugfixes[/b][/u]

[*]Small Resolution Issues Fixed

[*]Increased the size of the options menu

[*]Fixed hierarchy Lines Issues.

[*]Duke End game parameter no longer pixelated.

[*]Add a mask to agents actions tab so it may be infinitely scrollable.

[*]Sometimes the questioning mechanism shows “Failure” while succeeding because you used all of 
your questions.

[*]When a property is destroyed by an event and a repair is suggested, the payment is done but the 
repair does not.

[*]Robbing a rich patron option balanced to result in less gold.

[*]Sorting characters via selection window by skills show wrong numbers for some skills.

[*]End game parameters show the wrong tooltips…

[*]Can no longer capture constabulary properties as other characters (Will probably change in the 
future)

[*]You can kill god (and shouldn’t be able to)

[*]No longer able to arson faction leader properties…

[*]“Character in prison” message makes some options displayable even when they are not valid for the 
item.

[*]The player could react to popups via keyboard during turn-pass loading (Results in many different bugs)

[*]Some key characters were recruited by AI as guards or employees

[*]Can view character info of characters which shouldn’t be viewed, for God / Constabulary Report / 
Your Agent / ETC…

[*]Can View character info in letters log… (Some of them shouldn’t be viewed)


[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]

[*]Sporadic: The cutscenes are not displayed properly on Linux platforms.

[*]The audio volumes lack proportions in the Linux Platform.
[*]16:10 Screens will sometimes set the game to a 16:10 ratio res, an unsupported ratio which results in UI bugs.





[b][u]Planned for future versions:[/u][/b]

[b]V0.8[/b]
[*]More property events
[*]Cults
[*]A Plot that makes the target faction more suspicious to the constabulary.
[*]A Plot that decreases the target faction’s reputation.
[*]Double Transposition / Scytale Encryptions.

[*]Constabulary - investigation related characters should be shown outside of the map along with the things you know about them.
[*]Constabulary - Promotions chart hierarchy shown outside of the map.
[*]Turn events refreshed and displayed as Event + Count?
More tips
[*]Higher Ambient Light For Letters
[*]Better corruption effect.
[*]Feedback related additions


[b]v0.9[/b]

[*]Chapter 3

[b]v1.0[/b]

notes.title: Update - Version 065
notes.content:
This is a very small update, for the latest big update 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1380010/view/2843415083681247703]Click Here[/url]

[h2][u][b]--Added--
[/b][/u][/h2]
[list]

[*]Linux Support

[*]New option in Tavern Brawl event.

[*]Additional tooltip for false arrest.

[*]Old trait (Older people are weaker physically) (Test)

[*]Misc Gameplay Adjustments
[/list]

[h2][u][b]--Bug Fixes--
[/b][/u][/h2]
[list]
[*]Some encrypted letters couldn’t be deciphered because the final words were obscured and not interactable.

[*]Lower chances for devastating property events to occur and if they do, more options to resolve them without total destruction of the property.

[*]Your agents will send you fewer messages so it will feel less spammy.

[*]Some traits are now restricted by character age. 

[*]6 guards pirates option was not available even when the player had 6 guards in the property.

[*]Book keeper quests sometimes targeted the player's faction properties.

[/list]

notes.title: Update - Version 06
notes.content:
[h2][u]Changes (Version 0.6)[/u][/h2]

[h3][u][b]--Added--[/b][/u][/h3]

[*] Animated glow on specific quests which shouldn’t be missed.

[*] Random events for early game properties
[*]- Tavern +3 events
[*]-Brothel +2 events
[*]-Wharf +2 Events
[*]-Transport Ship +1 Event
[*]-Every Ship Property +3 Events
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/6784d2f9467afa970890eaa85145bcae05196e28.png[/img]

[*]Updated to unity version 2020, should, maybe, fix some of the issues in the game.

[*]Optimized a whole lot of things.

[*]-Rendering should cost a lot less from the machine.

[*]-Some processing had been optimized.

[*]- Slightly Faster Menu Loading...

[*] Displaying message when cunning / stealth during combat.

[*]Explained upgrading properties better.

[*]Added Tips to loading screens.

[*]Idling too much / spamming turns in order to gain resources has now a counter mechanism that results in your factions ultimate destruction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/794c5c5e89a43e30af9073ebd6886c66982c54c1.png[/img]

[*]Constabulary Questioning - Trying a question reveals the opponent's answer type.

[*]Tutorial for “high constable is your puppet”

[*]Enemy raids now result in stealing 25% of your inventory.

[*]Loading game now randomizes the music at the current playlist, in order to prevent repetitiveness.

[*]New agents status panel, in which you may see what every agent is currently doing (OR NOT 
DOING).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/84e3edc98c1ee6b9af21e73192811cd666a261d7.png[/img]

[*]Separate “Property View” button, unlockable by researching Real-Estate, allows the player to see and filter properties in the game.
Bribing prices now change from a character to a character and depends on its stats.

[*]Characters who had lost jobs would enter a pool and be recruited later instead of new chars.

[*]Agent tooltips should now display their skills as well.

[*]Scout location should now gather 1 information piece about 1 random employee / owner

[*]Agents talking about locations from time to time will now point out which location and which district 
they are talking about.

[*]Added a combat log for duels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/2c917d458bd5675ab25d9c920a326bb68c3982b8.png[/img]

[*]Added Gambler / Drug Addict traits which makes some characters hang out in specific places.

[*]The game now attempts to store recent plot decisions, so if the plot window opens again on the same plot, it will display the same parameters.

[*]Longer shortcut for cheats, enabling cheats should now display cheats prompt.

[*]Add small label under puzzle solved - “Click Here To Resolve”

[*]Add new music.

[*]Now plotters affect the plot, by adding a bonus to each participant. The bonus is based on how well the planned the scheme, the quality of the plan depends on their “intelligent” skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38420011/e7faf3b7c9f65ddc74d94fe0f3cec034b8014c0c.png[/img]
[*] Added “Play As Constabulary” Tutorial.
 



[h3][u][b]-- Fixed -- [/b][/u][/h3]

[*]Constabulary steady resource flow ceases when loading a game.

[*]Notifications that lionel spinkel can replace lionel spinkel.

[*]Pressing on opponent question turns it invisible

[*]Saving and loading makes the people in the recruitment pool unknown…

[*]Non-agent minions may also get promoted over the player. 

[*]Killing faction heads will ruin save files.

[*]Prompt Messages may be stuck and then released after a specific message.

[*]Issues with small resolutions.

[*]Abductions & Assassinations done by the enemy always result in the agent not getting abducted.

[*]Spelling errors

[*]Some issues that caused the game to become stuck.

[*]Information Gathered UI had an error.

[*]Unique NPC characters that shouldn’t appear in the character view screen.

[*]Sometimes loading games while having an arrow at the map will keep the arrow hovering…

[*]Character window  does not appear instantly when unlocked..? (Post load game)

[*]Hierarchy Tree Issues Fixed.

[*]Clicking on actions now should not deselect an agent.

[*]Prevented gathering information from characters you know everything  about.

[*]Fixed the raven’s animation.

[*]Right click menu should now disappear when selecting different properties and when a portrait is no 
longer active on the quest panel.

[*]Fixed the number letter encryption’s lines so they will fit better.

[*]Knowing the employees visuals will no longer display it as a question mark on the location view…

[*]Deceased characters from execution will now be transported to the cemetery…

[*]Disabled characters will no longer be recruited from the pool…

[*]Other factions can no longer take over the mysterious ship before the player does.

[*]Large number of connections in recruitment cost not displayed correctly


[*]After some tasks, agents will sporadically not go back to their job tasks…

[*]Past location status panels visible when re-entering map (Not relevant panels)

[*]Fixed Relationship modifiers not loaded from a save file.



[h3][b][u]Known Issues [/u][/b][/h3]

[*]Some specific screen ratio’s default resolution may cause issues with the UI. (Can be fixed by 

changing to any of the available resolutions)

[*]Issue with the first line at hierarchy trees. (Requires refactoring the tree system)

[*]Sporadic: Post manor upgrade - agents are not selectable / disappear after loading the game / wont 
appear on plots.

[*]Sporadic: Random Employee in constabulary can be a 9 years old child.

[*]Sporadic: Altering settings crash for some people

[*]Sporadic: Loading the game while in the game may cause inability to progress trough turns…

[*]Sporadic: Puzzle may not appear as resolved up until the moment it’s refreshed.

[*]Sporadic: Owners shift after loading a game?




[h3][u][b]Plans for the next version[/b][/u][/h3]

[*]A lot of events for the constabulary, so they may not only rely on their passive resource flow, this 
should have been implemented in this version but was  

[*]A lot of focus on more stuff to do in the different rooms, more paranoia / atmosphere / story / hidden 
things / plot related content / etc.

[*]More property events, for later game properties in particular.

[*]Letters series that tell parts of a story, which may be collected randomly by scouting specific locations (Wilderness?)…

[*]More puzzles, conceptualize presenting: Scytale , Hill Cipher , Autokey vigenere, Double transposition in the game.

----

Give feedback on this game's development:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1380010/discussions/

This is mostly what updates are populated by.

[*]
